paragraphs.text: Hanuman is a 2005 Indian Hindi-language animated feature film directed by V. G. Samant and produced by Percept Picture Company and Silvertoons. The animated film dramatizes the life of its title character, Hanuman, a Hindu deity. The animation was provided by Silvertoons.

The film popularised animation and kickstarted the growth of India's animation industry. At the International Indian Film Academy Awards, the film won an award for "A Special Award for Innovation in Indian Cinema". The Telugu dubbed version was titled as Hanuman - Jai Bajarangabali and a game was released as part of the film's promotional strategy.
